scope: Coax constructs all own-code JSON/header/word/publication/process-identity controls and owns every verdict. Existing independently authored Python interval and pixel equations are invoked only as reference-oracle functions, not their full product gates.

geometry.negative_exception_types: AssertionError for oracle and ABI losses; RuntimeError/source digests differ for stale gate.
geometry.source_fence_epochs: Initial small fixture run was extended with a complete observer/compiler/mock/source fence, then final exception-type controls were tightened; each changed source image is retained through receipt hashes and logs.

pipeline.negative_exception_type: Every loss must be an actual AssertionError, not any process failure.

limitations: Only identical bounded unit fixtures and independent-oracle controls; no producer geometry, Grid CPU/raster, device or model run.
Selected older observer compiler is not current-source or release qualification.
No equations, tolerances, expected fixtures or original oracle implementations were changed.
